question: In the 2008/2009 season, find the country with the highest average weight of players who appeared as home team starters (e.g., home_player_1) in the league that hosted the most matches.

prediction.sql:
SELECT c.XCL_002
FROM Country c
JOIN League l ON c.XCL_001 = l.XCL_004
JOIN Match m ON l.XCL_003 = m.XCL_008
JOIN Player p ON m.XCL_061 = p.XCL_122
WHERE m.XCL_009 = '2008/2009'
  AND m.XCL_008 = (
    SELECT m2.XCL_008
    FROM Match m2
    WHERE m2.XCL_009 = '2008/2009'
    GROUP BY m2.XCL_008
    ORDER BY COUNT(m2.XCL_006) DESC
    LIMIT 1
  )
GROUP BY c.XCL_001, c.XCL_002
ORDER BY AVG(p.XCL_127) DESC
LIMIT 1

JOIN League l ON c.XCL_001 = l.XCL_004
JOIN Match m ON l.XCL_003 = m.XCL_008
JOIN Player p ON m.XCL_061 = p.XCL_122
WHERE m.XCL_009 = '2008/2009'

GROUP BY c.XCL_001, c.XCL_002
ORDER BY AVG(p.XCL_127) DESC
LIMIT 1
